audienceActivation.mappingGuidance:
Pinterest Customer Lists accept two identifier columns. Use these names verbatim as `to`; they are what get_audience_destination_schema returns in fields[].name.
- EMAIL — the user's email address.
- MAID — a mobile advertising ID (AAID on Android; IDFA only where Pinterest's policy allows it).

Map both when you have both: Pinterest matches a user if any identifier matches, so sending email and MAID gives a higher match rate than either alone.

Phone numbers are not supported yet: do not map a PHONE column. A mapping whose `to` is PHONE is ignored, and a row whose only identifier is a phone fails with "No valid Pinterest identifier (EMAIL / MAID)".

Hashing: with isHashRequired true (the default) send RAW warehouse values and the integration normalizes and SHA-256 hashes them. With isHashRequired false, every value must already be the SHA-256 hex digest of the lowercased, trimmed email or the lowercased MAID; unhashed values are rejected or fail to match.

Don't send IDFA collected from iOS app or website activity — Pinterest's policy forbids it.

Pinterest needs at least 100 matched users and 48–72 hours before an audience can be targeted.

AD ACCOUNT: the ad account id is not discoverable through these operations. An agent MUST have `adAccountId` set on the destination config before calling listAudiences or setup; ask the user for it rather than guessing.
